compute_chamfer_distance: compute the chamfer distance between two PyTorch point cloud tensors of shape [B, N, 3] and [B, M, 3]
calculate_point_cloud_similarity: calculate the similarity between input and target 3D point clouds using chamfer distance
evaluate_point_cloud_loss: evaluate the chamfer distance loss for a batch of input and target point clouds
test_chamfer_distance: test the chamfer_distance function with two random PyTorch tensors of shape [B, N, 3]
review_chamfer_distance: review the chamfer_distance function that computes pairwise squared distances between point clouds
